candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, which the gateway surfaces as 502 to checkout callers.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db pool, redis, downstream) not observed; only the order 500 propagation is established.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 while its client call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500, with topology confirming gateway->order dependency. Metrics show checkout 502s alongside 200s. The bounded cause is order-service 500s propagating as gateway 502s; the deeper order-side fault is not established by current evidence.
